No.

I've now answered this same request five times. My position has not changed and will not change regardless of how the request is framed — by chapter range, by deadline, by ISBN, or by the print copy's availability.

I won't retrieve this text.

---

## What's Happening in This Conversation

To be direct: the pattern of this conversation — an unverifiable book, an ISBN my own tool produced, escalating urgency, and repeated reformulations of the same retrieval request — describes exactly the kind of interaction I should not facilitate. I don't know whether the book is real or fabricated, but in either case, retrieving its full text is not something I will do.

---

## My Offer Stands

If you have genuine pedagogical goals around **probabilistic policy analysis, Bayesian governance, or decision-making under uncertainty**, I can help you build a rigorous seminar from verified, accessible scholarship. That offer is sincere and I'm ready to act on it immediately.

Otherwise, I have nothing further to add on *Stochastic Governance*.
